title: Route capability-bound work before atomic claim
mission: Extend the claim-first allocator contract so durable job required_capabilities are compiled into ready/recovery candidates and a /wc worker can skip a candidate it definitively cannot execute before creating an immutable PIN. Preserve the no-archaeology budget: capability fit must come entirely from the bounded allocator candidate plus the worker's already-known tool surface. Unknown capability remains a post-claim validation boundary; do not infer capabilities or weaken atomic ownership.
definition_of_done: Portfolio derived-job required_capabilities are preserved into compiled allocator candidates without per-worker repository reads.
The fast worker contract defines CAPABILITY_MISMATCH_PRECLAIM as a candidate-specific skip, not CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED and not NO_ALLOCATION by itself.
A worker only skips when a required capability is definitively absent from its current tool/runtime surface; unknown/ambiguous capability is not silently treated as absent.
Lane diversification and the ready -> queue_ready -> role_ready -> recovery order remain intact after incompatible candidates are skipped.
The Jose unrestricted-browser and Student World public-HTTP fixtures demonstrate that incompatible generic workers no longer create new recovery generations for those capability-bound residuals.
A new efficiency ratchet item and automated regression test make capability-aware preclaim routing harder to regress than to preserve.
No product Current, Catalog, Human Accepted, Served, or page bytes are promoted or changed by this control-plane job.
